home.factory_desc: Located strategically along National Road 3, our heavy engineering and wood joinery plant is equipped with German CNC cutting machinery, automatic timber kiln dryers, and standard load-testing trusses. Producing our architectural materials locally allows us to commit to fast timelines and execute highly tailored specs for premium contractors.
home.factory_bullet_1: American Walnut kiln drying control line.
home.factory_bullet_2: Pre-fabricated structural steel welding standard ISO 3834.
home.why_choose_desc: We bridge architectural design with heavy manufacturing to establish exceptional risk mitigation.
home.why_choose_card_desc_1: Precision milling guarantees that complex architectural designs translate exactly to wood joinery profiles with 0.1mm tolerance.
home.why_choose_card_desc_2: Our internal seasoning kilns lower wood moisture levels to 10-12%, completely preventing warping or cracking under Cambodia's humid weather.
home.why_choose_card_desc_3: Independently validated fire doors engineered with expanding intumescent smoke gaskets to block heat transfer for up to two hours.
home.process_desc: Delivering structural integrity and exquisite aesthetic finishes systematically.
process.step01.title: Consultation & Engineering
process.step01.desc: Deep structural analysis, architectural concept design, and engineering optimization to finalize material specifications.
process.step02.title: Factory Fabrication
process.step02.desc: High-precision manufacturing in our 25,000 sqm facility using state-of-the-art CNC machining and rigorous quality control.
process.step03.title: On-Site Installation
process.step03.desc: Seamless deployment, steel erection, facade fitting, and premium joinery installation managed by certified engineers.
process.step04.title: Certification & Handover
process.step04.desc: Rigorous safety audits, compliance certification (UL/ISO standards), and polished handover of your premium space.
testimonial.1.quote: SDY C&I delivered our Vattanac Tower corporate office fit-out with absolute craftsmanship. Their interior joinery and UL fire doors surpassed our international audit standards.
testimonial.1.author: Lim Chanrath
testimonial.2.quote: The structural steel fabrication for our factory in Kampong Speu was completed 3 weeks ahead of schedule with 100% precision. SDY is our long-term structural partner.
testimonial.2.author: Sven Johansson
testimonial.3.quote: Working with SDY for our Koh Pich villa was an outstanding client experience. Their custom furniture designers turned our abstract vision into absolute bespoke luxury.
testimonial.3.author: Neak Oknha S. Samnang
home.consultations_desc: Coordinate with our engineering estimators. Send site dimensions or structural specs and download compliance certificates directly.
